listings.title: 1999 Ibanez RG7620-VK Vampire Kiss Electric Guitar Incomplete Japan
listings.description:
1999 Ibanez RG7620-VK Vampire Kiss Electric Guitar Incomplete Japan


Here's a decent RG7620 project for someone.  I have too many projects right now, so this one's looking for a new home. The body has a fair share of chips, but is solid.  The neck is in good shape, frets have lots of life left, truss rod works as it should, and no locking nut mounting hole cracks on the back of the neck.  Comes with original Gotoh tuners, locking nut, and string retainer.  The pickups are NOS oem Dimarzio custom 7, and have never been hooked up, so you'll have to do some minor soldering work.  It also has the spring claw, and tremolo pivot studs included.  It doesn't come with a Ibanez lo pro edge 7 string tremolo.  Comes with an older Ibanez hard shell case.  Comes as is, no returns.
Thanks, and have a great day/night!

listings.title: Ibanez RT450 Standard MIJ Japanese RG Alder Road Worn Body Husk
listings.description: For sale a rare well beat up Ibanez RT 450 MIJ Japanese RG Body made of alder. This takes a standard two point tremolo and a 1980s Ibanez style extended fretboard for 24 frets. You can probably use a 22 fret neck with a pickguard that covers the extended fretboard inset to modify into a custom project. Well used and plenty beat up, but a genuine road worn guitar for absolute mojo vibes.

listings.title: Used Ibanez RG1570 Prestige Team J. Craft Electric Loaded Guitar Body 2002 - Mirage Blue Made in Japan
listings.description: Up for sale is the body of an Ibanez RG1570 electric guitar. Someone did some mods to the bridge cavity of this one and the original Edge Pro bridge does not function in this guitar anymore. It will need additional modification, or a different bridge set up, to make this body work. It comes loaded with the original electronics, that are fully functional, back plate with mounting screws, control cavity plates, and strap buttons. The Edge Pro tremolo bridge is included with springs and a tremolo bridge. The body has a lot of dings and scratches that the previous owner tried to fix with touch up paint, rather poorly. Check out the pictures for the condition. Because of the mods in the bridge cavity, we are selling this one AS IS, for parts or repair.

listings.title: 1987 Ibanez RG420 Roadstar MIJ FujiGen – Original Edge – HH – Refinished
listings.description:
This is a rare Fujigen RG420 from Japan 1987 that is unusual because its a transitional model that combined the compact Roadstar body with the pointed headstock that would become standard on the RG, only this has a non-angled headstock with “Roadstar Series” logo next to the what was a re-designed 1st appearance of the Ibanez logo that they’ve kept ever since.

It is the immediate predecessor to the modern RG: an old-style Roadstar body equipped with several features that carried into the modern RG era—Edge tremolo, locking nut, slim neck, pointed headstock and the RG model prefix.


It is a great playing guitar but is currently in “project stasis” I bought it like this with the intention to fix up but never got around to it.


The neck pickup is the original and it functions but theres no bridge pickup and theres a crack in the back of the headstock that needs to be glued and clamped. it doesnt affect the playability of the guitar or tuning. Pots need a deep cleaning or replacement. It is missing it’s whammy bar. Switch tip is also broken off. Im selling as-is but wd be easy project to get going and its a fantastic guitar. It has a nice ring acoustically and the neck is very fun to play. the neck pickup does work.

See the video i uploaded

listings.description:
Condition

Heavy damage: The tone knob has been pushed into the body. There is oil debris on the bottom of the body. Missing: Missing a bolt on the neck for the Floyd Rose.

Description

The RG is the most recognizable and distinctive guitar in the Ibanez line. Three decades of metal have forged this high-performance machine, honing it for both speed and strength. Whether you favor a hardtail (fixed) bridge or Ibanez's industry-leading locking tremolo system, the RG is a precision instrument. The Iron Label line was originally developed with metal and nothing but metal in mind. Ibanez modded and tweaked until they got to the heaviest-hitting metal axes we’ve ever built. They’re purposefully spartan, and you won’t find a feature here that doesn't contribute directly to a bone rattling, earth shattering tones these guitars pump out. Carrying forward that same philosophy, the next generation of Iron Label guitars take this raw metal energy to a completely new level. They sport totally blacked out looks, and their supercharged electronics amounting to some of the heaviest-swinging metal axes ever produced.

Product Features

  • Ibanez's Thin, Flat and Fast Wizard Neck is Strong and Sturdy and Offers Unlimited Playability
  • Ebony Fretboard Produces Tight Lows and Mid Range with a Strong Attack in the High End, Quick Response and Rich Sustain
  • DiMarzio® D Activator™ Pickups have a Powerful, Clean, and Open Sound with Excellent Harmonic Overtones and Very Tight Low-End Response
  • Gotoh® Machine Heads Provide Superior Precision, a Smooth Feel, and Excellent Tuning Accuracy
  • The Edge Zero II Bridge Design Features a Lower Profile Tremolo for Playing Comfort and Stud Lock Function for Stable Tuning
  • The dyna-MIX 10 Offers Ten Sound Variations and Can Easily Switch from Humbucker and Single Coil Modes with the Mini Switch
